name: Interface inventory
description: List local interfaces, addresses, status and MTU.

name: Wireless interface inventory
description: Find Linux wireless interfaces without assuming a specific adapter name.

name: Wi-Fi scan execution
description: Trigger the existing platform scanner or validate supplied scan observations.

name: Normalise BSSID
description: Validate and canonicalise a BSSID/MAC address.

name: Normalise SSID
description: Remove control characters and preserve hidden SSIDs as an empty string.

name: Classify frequency band
description: Map a frequency in MHz to 2.4, 5 or 6 GHz.

name: Frequency to channel
description: Convert a Wi-Fi frequency in MHz to its channel number.

name: Channel to frequency
description: Convert a channel to MHz when its band is specified.

name: Signal quality score
description: Calculate a bounded 0–100 RSSI quality score.

name: Signal strength class
description: Classify RSSI using conservative signal-strength bands.

name: Measured SNR
description: Calculate SNR only when a real noise measurement was supplied.

name: Sort by signal
description: Sort detected access points from strongest to weakest RSSI.

name: Filter by band
description: Filter the current scan by 2.4, 5 or 6 GHz.

name: Filter by security
description: Filter networks by a security label, case-insensitively.

name: Open access points
description: List networks that advertise no link-layer security.

name: WPA3 access points
description: List networks advertising WPA3 or SAE.

name: Hidden SSIDs
description: List BSS entries that do not disclose an SSID.

name: Deduplicate scan
description: Keep one record per BSSID, preferring the strongest observation.

name: Compare scans
description: Compare current and previous scans by BSSID.

name: Scan summary
description: Summarise network counts, bands, security and average measured RSSI.

name: Strongest networks
description: Return the top N strongest networks.

name: Weakest networks
description: Return the weakest N networks to identify edge-of-coverage APs.

name: Group by SSID
description: Group BSS records by visible SSID, preserving hidden entries separately.

name: Strongest BSSID per SSID
description: Select the strongest BSSID observation for each SSID.

name: OUI vendor lookup
description: Resolve common locally bundled OUI prefixes without making a network call.

name: Locally administered MAC check
description: Inspect the locally-administered and multicast bits in a MAC address.

name: Randomised MAC indicator
description: Flag MAC addresses whose locally-administered bit is set.

name: Channel congestion map
description: Count nearby BSS and adjacent 2.4 GHz channel overlap.

name: 2.4 GHz overlap analysis
description: Estimate co-channel and adjacent-channel overlap using 20 MHz channel spacing.

name: Recommend 2.4 GHz channel
description: Rank channels 1, 6 and 11 by observed adjacent BSS count.

name: Recommend 5 GHz channel
description: Rank common non-DFS 5 GHz channels by observed occupancy.

name: Recommend 6 GHz channel
description: Rank 6 GHz preferred scanning channels by observed occupancy.

name: Channel quality score
description: Calculate relative channel score from observed congestion counts.

name: DFS channel check
description: Identify common 5 GHz DFS channels.

name: 6 GHz PSC check
description: Check whether a 6 GHz channel is a Preferred Scanning Channel.

name: Recommend channel width
description: Suggest a conservative channel width using observations from the selected band.

name: Band distribution
description: Count BSS entries in each Wi-Fi band.

name: Security distribution
description: Count observed networks by advertised security label.

name: Vendor distribution
description: Count networks by locally known OUI vendor prefix.

name: Parse iw scan output
description: Parse Linux iw BSS blocks into structured network observations.

name: Parse iwlist scan output
description: Parse common iwlist scan cells.

name: Parse Windows netsh scan output
description: Parse netsh wlan show networks mode=bssid text.

name: Parse macOS airport scan output
description: Parse the legacy airport -s tabular output.

name: Parse macOS system_profiler JSON
description: Extract nearby wireless networks from system_profiler JSON.

name: Parse iw station dump
description: Extract station counters from iw station dump output.

name: Parse iw link
description: Extract connected SSID, BSSID, frequency and signal from iw link.

name: Parse ethtool link details
description: Parse speed, duplex, link state and autonegotiation from ethtool output.

name: Parse Linux IPv4 default route
description: Extract gateway and interface from ip route output.

name: Parse Linux ARP/neighbour table
description: Parse common arp -an output into IP/MAC pairs.

name: Parse Windows ARP table
description: Parse arp -a IPv4 entries on Windows.

name: Parse resolv.conf
description: Extract valid nameserver IPs from resolv.conf text.

name: Parse ping output
description: Extract transmitted, received, loss and RTT summary from ping text.

name: Parse traceroute output
description: Extract hop number, host and RTT samples from traceroute text.

name: Validate network record
description: Validate essential fields and report missing/invalid observations.

name: Validate scan payload
description: Check a list of network records and return valid/invalid counts.

name: Subnet summary
description: Summarise an IPv4 or IPv6 interface/CIDR.

name: IP in subnet check
description: Check whether an address belongs to a supplied subnet.

name: Default gateway lookup
description: Extract the first default gateway from supplied route output.

name: DNS server extraction
description: Collect DNS resolver addresses from resolv.conf or supplied list.

name: Reverse DNS lookup
description: Resolve a supplied IP address using the system resolver.

name: DNS lookup timing
description: Time a hostname lookup using the system resolver.

name: Latency summary
description: Summarise latency samples with min, median, p95 and max.

name: Packet loss calculator
description: Calculate packet loss percentage from sent and received counters.

name: Jitter calculator
description: Calculate mean absolute consecutive RTT variation.

name: Interface counter delta
description: Calculate monotonic counter deltas and handle counter resets.

name: Interface throughput
description: Calculate RX/TX throughput in Mbps from byte-counter snapshots.

name: Packet error rate
description: Compute RX/TX error ratio from interface packet counters.

name: URL inspection
description: Validate a URL scheme and return parsed host, port and path without fetching it.

name: TLS certificate expiry
description: Read the expiry date of a TLS certificate with a short connection timeout.

name: Security strength rank
description: Rank a network security mode from open through WPA3.

name: Security warnings
description: Generate transparent warnings for open, WEP and legacy WPA observations.

name: Rogue AP candidates
description: Flag same-SSID BSSIDs that are not in a supplied trusted BSSID list.

name: Evil-twin similarity check
description: Find different BSSIDs advertising the same non-empty SSID.

name: Duplicate BSSID check
description: Detect duplicate BSSID records in one scan.

name: Weak signal alerts
description: Generate alerts for networks below a configurable RSSI threshold.

name: Open Wi-Fi alerts
description: Create alert records for open access points.

name: WPA2/WPA3 transition mode
description: Identify networks advertising both SAE and PSK transition security.

name: Redact MAC address
description: Mask the final three octets of a MAC address for sharing.

name: Redact SSID
description: Replace visible SSIDs with stable labels for sharing.

name: Anonymise scan
description: Redact SSIDs and BSSIDs before exporting a scan.

name: Stable SSID hash
description: Create a non-reversible SHA-256 fingerprint of an SSID.

name: Scan fingerprint
description: Fingerprint a canonicalised scan for integrity/change tracking.

name: Alert severity classifier
description: Assign a severity for common Wi-Fi alert types.

name: Deduplicate alerts
description: Remove repeated alerts by type, BSSID and message.

name: Alert threshold evaluator
description: Compare a numeric metric with a configured warning/critical threshold.

name: Export JSON
description: Serialise current networks and optional metadata as formatted JSON.

name: Export CSV
description: Export network records as RFC-compliant CSV.

name: Export HTML report
description: Generate an escaped standalone HTML table report from scan observations.

name: Prometheus scan metrics
description: Export counts and RSSI gauges in Prometheus text format.

name: Network health report
description: Build a concise evidence-based report from supplied live observations.

name: Trim signal history window
description: Return only the most recent N signal history samples.

name: Signal trend
description: Estimate signal trend from ordered RSSI samples using least-squares slope.

name: Signal percentiles
description: Calculate RSSI p10, median and p90 for the provided sample set.

name: Rank channels
description: Rank observed channel occupancy within a requested band.

name: Format bytes
description: Format a byte count using IEC units.

name: Format duration
description: Format elapsed seconds as days, hours, minutes and seconds.

name: Safe filename
description: Normalise a name for a local export filename.

name: Validate application settings
description: Validate polling and scan settings before saving.

name: Backend health report
description: Return runtime version, mode and feature-plugin count.

name: Wi-Fi generation classifier
description: Infer the highest advertised PHY generation from supplied PHY capability flags.

name: Same-SSID band presence
description: Group visible SSIDs by advertised band and count their BSSID observations.

name: Band-steering evidence
description: Compare measured RSSI for the same SSID across bands without inferring AP steering decisions.

name: Roaming candidate ranking
description: Rank same-SSID BSSIDs by measured signal improvement over the connected BSSID.

name: Association roam events
description: Diff client association snapshots and classify roam, network-change, connect and disconnect events.

name: Roaming timeline summary
description: Summarise observed roaming and network-change events per client from association diffs.

name: Sticky-client candidates
description: Flag weak client associations when supplied AP-side observations show a stronger same-SSID alternative.

name: Association dwell summary
description: Calculate per-client and per-BSSID association dwell durations from supplied timestamp intervals.

name: Roam latency summary
description: Compare latency measurements before and after roaming, preserving sample counts and median values.

name: Roaming stability score
description: Calculate a transparent heuristic from observed roam events per client and a chosen time window.

name: Band occupancy delta
description: Compare per-band BSS observation counts between two scans.

name: Channel width frequency range
description: Calculate the nominal occupied frequency span for a channel centre and channel width.

name: Frequency overlap score
description: Compute frequency-span overlap between two channel observations with measured widths.

name: Channel separation ranking
description: Rank candidate channel centres by minimum non-overlap separation from observed channel spans.

name: Channel overlap pairs
description: Find overlapping nominal channel spans in a set of access-point observations.

name: DFS frequency intersection
description: Check whether a nominal 5 GHz channel span intersects the commonly used DFS frequency range.

name: 6 GHz PSC availability plan
description: List Preferred Scanning Channels not present in a supplied 6 GHz scan.

name: Wi-Fi 7 EHT capability summary
description: Summarise explicitly supplied EHT and Wi-Fi 7 capability flags without inferring unsupported features.

name: Multi-Link Operation summary
description: Summarise supplied Wi-Fi 7 MLO link records by active state, band and signal.

name: Protected Management Frames audit
description: Audit explicit PMF/802.11w states from scan or controller observations.

name: Regulatory channel allowlist check
description: Compare observed channels against an OS/controller-supplied regional allowlist.

name: Client association inventory
description: Join AP/controller client associations to advertised BSS records and report unmatched associations.

name: Stale client detector
description: Identify client records whose supplied last-seen timestamps exceed a configurable age threshold.

name: Airtime fairness summary
description: Calculate measured per-client airtime allocation and Jain fairness from AP/controller counters.

name: Client throughput fairness
description: Calculate per-client transmit/receive throughput and Jain fairness from byte deltas over a measured interval.

name: DSCP traffic distribution
description: Summarise packet counts by observed six-bit DSCP value from a supplied capture or controller export.

name: Application QoS policy audit
description: Compare observed per-application DSCP markings with an explicit operator-supplied policy map.

name: Client retry rate
description: Calculate per-client retransmission ratios from AP-reported transmit and retry counters.

name: PHY rate asymmetry
description: Compare measured uplink and downlink PHY rates for associated clients.

name: Client/AP capability compatibility
description: Compare advertised client and AP band/feature sets and list unsupported client requirements.

name: OFDMA and MU-MIMO evidence
description: Summarise explicit AP/controller OFDMA and MU-MIMO support and usage counters.

name: Target Wake Time summary
description: Summarise explicitly advertised and active 802.11ax Target Wake Time sessions.

name: 802.11k/v/r capability audit
description: Report explicit neighbour-report, BSS-transition and fast-transition capabilities per AP.

name: Mobility domain consistency
description: Find same-ESS APs with missing or inconsistent 802.11r mobility-domain identifiers.

name: DHCP lease audit
description: Find expired leases and duplicate IP or MAC assignments in a supplied DHCP lease snapshot.

name: DNS resolver latency comparison
description: Compare measured resolver lookup success, median and p95 latency across supplied probes.

name: Gateway reachability matrix
description: Summarise reachability and latency evidence from explicit gateway/next-hop probes.

name: Roaming interruption analysis
description: Measure disconnect-to-reconnect interruption duration for client handover event pairs.

name: Disconnect reason summary
description: Classify and count IEEE 802.11 disassociation/deauthentication reason codes in supplied logs.

name: Association rejection summary
description: Classify IEEE 802.11 association response status codes from supplied AP/controller logs.

name: Connection health evidence
description: Flag measured per-client link quality concerns using explicit and configurable signal, retry, rate, loss and latency evidence.

name: Multi-site access-point inventory snapshot
description: Normalise AP inventories across sites, preserve explicit radio centre-frequency evidence for channel-width planning, surface duplicate BSSIDs and measure inventory-field coverage.

parameters.access_points: Up to 2048 AP records with site, BSSID, band, channel and width; optional center_frequency_mhz is preserved when supplied and is required for planner use of wide channels.

name: Access-point topology relationships
description: Separate physical/backhaul and RF-neighbour relationships while flagging unresolved or cyclic links.

name: Site subnet and gateway correlation
description: Match AP management addresses to explicit site CIDRs and report ambiguous or invalid gateway relationships.

name: Floor-plan AP anchor validation
description: Validate AP floor-plan coordinates and surface missing references or collocated anchors.

name: Site inventory snapshot diff
description: Compare AP snapshots for additions, removals, metadata changes and site moves.

name: Site network segment capacity
description: Calculate subnet capacity and utilisation from explicitly supplied allocation counts.

name: Site gateway redundancy audit
description: Review gateway failover groups, duplicate addresses and reported active/standby state.

name: Floor-plan zone assignment
description: Assign AP anchors to explicit room polygons and surface out-of-zone or overlapping placements.

name: Site topology redundancy audit
description: Identify physical-backhaul cut links, articulation APs and disconnected components.

name: Site topology snapshot diff
description: Compare AP inventory and explicit physical/RF topology edges between two snapshots.

name: Multi-site AP inventory comparison
description: Compare AP counts, bands, vendors, models and firmware distributions and flag cross-site BSSID reuse.

name: AP observation freshness audit
description: Detect stale and future-dated AP observations while treating missing timestamps as unknown.

name: Site AP channel reuse audit
description: Identify co-channel reuse and adjacent-channel overlap from supplied same-site radio widths and centres.

name: Site topology history timeline
description: Summarise AP and link changes across up to 256 timestamped, caller-supplied topology snapshots.

name: Site AP-to-gateway path audit
description: Trace AP backhaul paths to supplied gateway APs and distinguish unreachable, unknown and cross-site evidence.

name: Site radio configuration audit
description: Compare AP radio channel widths, security and transmit power with explicit site/band standards; missing observations remain unknown.

name: Interactive site topology visualisation
description: Create deterministic, per-site AP layers and typed physical/RF/cross-site links for interactive inspection in the Workbench.

name: Persistent site discovery history snapshot
description: Validate bounded timestamped AP/topology snapshots before saving to a local SQLite history database with per-site retention.

name: Site-to-site change report
description: Compare each site’s latest two stored snapshots, report AP/topology drift, and flag BSSID reuse across sites.

name: Consolidated site audit report
description: Combine inventory, topology, gateway, radio standards, subnet capacity, cross-site inventory and optional saved-history results into one evidence-based report.

name: Router agent capability negotiation
description: Negotiate versioned, advertised read-only capabilities against the OpenWrt adapter manifest and reject unsupported operations or write permissions.

name: OpenWrt snapshot normalizer
description: Normalise bounded board, interface, radio, station and route snapshots into a credential-free common schema.

name: Router agent health report
description: Track authenticated agent heartbeats and classify healthy, degraded, unhealthy, stale and future-dated status using server timestamps.

name: OpenWrt agent snapshot ingestion
description: Accept authenticated snapshots from registered agents, normalise before persistence, retain bounded history, and expose latest inventory data.

name: OpenWrt agent snapshot diff
description: Compare retained snapshots and identify board, interface, radio, client-association and route changes.

name: Router agent credential scope
description: Issue per-agent, read-only scoped bearer credentials with expiry, rotation and revocation; store only token hashes.

name: OpenWrt idempotent snapshot delivery
description: Accept UUID-keyed snapshot deliveries with safe retries, duplicate-content detection and bounded idempotency retention.

name: Router agent negotiation audit
description: Persist bounded, append-only records of adapter/schema versions and advertised, requested, negotiated and rejected read-only scopes.

name: UniFi controller snapshot normalizer
description: Import bounded, caller-supplied UniFi Network exports into the common AP, radio, client and network schema; omit secrets and make no controller connection.

name: MikroTik RouterOS snapshot normalizer
description: Import bounded RouterOS exports covering board/resource health, interfaces, wireless registrations, IP addresses, VLANs and DHCP leases; omit secrets and make no router connection.

name: Multi-vendor router snapshot drift report
description: Compare OpenWrt, UniFi or MikroTik normalized snapshots using stable record identities and bounded allow-listed changes; reject mixed vendors and omit unknown/secret fields.

name: Multi-vendor router fleet health audit
description: Audit normalized OpenWrt, UniFi and MikroTik snapshots for stale data, measured CPU/memory pressure, down interfaces/radios, offline APs and weak clients; unknown telemetry remains unknown.

name: Multi-vendor router subnet overlap audit
description: Correlate normalized OpenWrt interface, UniFi network and MikroTik address CIDRs within each site; report duplicate or overlapping IPv4/IPv6 ranges across routers.

name: Multi-vendor client roaming audit
description: Build normalized OpenWrt, UniFi and MikroTik client association timelines; identify observed AP handoffs, short multi-AP windows and weak measured RSSI while excluding wired clients.

name: OpenWrt and MikroTik route-table audit
description: Inspect normalized route tables, default routes, duplicates, routing tables and connected prefixes; flag questionable defaults and unmatched gateway prefixes without assuming recursive routes are unreachable.

name: Multi-vendor VLAN segmentation audit
description: Compare normalized UniFi network profiles and MikroTik VLAN interfaces within each site; identify inconsistent subnets/names, duplicate VLAN IDs, unknown parents and down interfaces.

name: Cross-router default-gateway redundancy audit
description: Compare configured OpenWrt/MikroTik default routes by site, IP family and routing table; distinguish single-router paths, shared next hops, multiple configured paths and unknown activation without claiming failover is proven.

name: Router incident alert policy evaluator
description: Apply site/adapter/code/severity/occurrence policies to normalized audit findings and generate deterministic new, ongoing, acknowledged and resolved alert candidates without sending notifications.

name: Router audit report bundle builder
description: Combine F174–F181 audit results into a versioned, site-filterable, credential-free JSON report with severity rollups, bounded findings and a deterministic SHA-256 content hash.

name: Router audit report comparator
description: Validate F182 bundle SHA-256 hashes and compare reports by source/site/router/resource identity; classify unchanged, changed, added and removed findings with section/site deltas and bounded detail output.

name: Timezone-aware router scheduled report planner
description: Validate daily, weekly and monthly report schedules and preview future occurrences with IANA timezones, DST gap/fold policies and short-month skip/clamp rules; does not run background jobs.

name: Allow-listed signed router webhook envelope builder
description: Create canonical event batches with HMAC-SHA256 signatures for exact allow-listed HTTPS DNS hostnames, timestamp/key headers and idempotency keys; prepares but never transmits requests.

name: Authenticated-encrypted router report archive
description: Encrypt and restore report/alert backup data using Scrypt-derived AES-256-GCM keys, authenticated metadata and strict bounded archive validation; the passphrase is never stored or returned.

name: Webhook egress and DNS-pinning policy verifier
description: Verify exact HTTPS host allowlists, public-only DNS answers, recent resolution, actual peer-IP pinning, TLS/hostname verification and redirect refusal without making network requests.

name: Scheduled router report job intake
description: Validate F184 occurrence IDs and F182 bundle hashes, derive stable job keys and place bounded report payloads into the durable lease-based SQLite worker queue with retries and dead-letter handling.

name: Scheduled report webhook delivery package builder
description: Require an active F188 worker lease, verify F182 report and payload hashes, gate on F187 fresh public DNS/TLS evidence, and create F185 HMAC-signed summary/finding events without sending a request.

name: Router webhook subscription router
description: Route normalized events using type/severity/site subscriptions; deduplicate events, produce deterministic bounded batches and enforce exact HTTPS host allowlists without accepting signing secrets or sending requests.

name: Bounded PCAP capture analyzer
description: Analyse classic PCAP and PCAPNG files up to 512 KiB, including multi-interface sections, declared section-length validation, per-interface timestamps and zero-snaplen semantics under a hard frame cap; analyse Ethernet, Linux cooked v1/v2, IPv4/IPv6, TCP/UDP, DSCP and 802.11/radiotap RSSI/noise/channel statistics without exposing packet payloads or endpoint addresses.

parameters.capture_base64: standard-base64 classic PCAP or PCAPNG file, decoded size up to 512 KiB

name: Multi-subscription webhook delivery orchestrator
description: Coordinate F190 subscription routing, F185 per-batch HMAC signing and F187 endpoint-specific DNS/TLS evidence; prepare independent deliveries or explain why each batch is blocked, without sending traffic or exposing signing secrets.

parameters.signing_keys: key_id-to-secret mapping held outside persistent event storage
parameters.egress_evidence: at most one matching F187 DNS/TLS evidence record per subscription

name: Webhook delivery reliability report
description: Summarise durable multi-subscription webhook delivery reliability, retries, latency, safe failure codes and per-site/per-subscription health using metadata-only records.

parameters.deliveries: up to 5000 sanitized webhook delivery metadata records

name: Enterprise WLAN security posture audit
description: Audit office, guest, IoT and management WLAN profiles for 802.1X/EAP policy, RADIUS redundancy, certificate validation, PMF, WPS and network segmentation. Distinguishes confirmed policy violations from missing evidence and never returns credentials or RADIUS addresses.

parameters.profiles: Up to 1024 normalized WLAN profile records with purpose, security mode, EAP, PMF, RADIUS and segmentation evidence
parameters.policy: Optional policy overrides for minimum enterprise security, approved EAP methods, RADIUS redundancy and required controls

name: Enterprise switch management-plane audit
description: Audit supplied switch evidence for secure management transports, SNMPv3 privacy, AAA/MFA, management ACLs, default accounts, encrypted backups, TLS syslog and authenticated time. Reports missing evidence separately and never returns secrets or management addresses.

parameters.switches: Up to 256 switch records with management protocols and security-control evidence.

name: Enterprise firewall policy audit
description: Review supplied inbound/outbound firewall defaults and rules for broad any/any access, exposed management ingress, duplicate policies and missing logging. Does not connect to firewalls or claim vendor-specific ACL shadowing.

parameters.firewalls: Up to 64 firewall records with default actions and up to 512 ordered rules each.

name: Enterprise DHCP and DNS security audit
description: Review DHCP snooping, rogue-server detection, trusted server inventories, Option 82, overlapping scopes, DNSSEC and encrypted upstream resolvers from supplied evidence only.

parameters.services: Up to 256 DHCP/DNS service records with bounded scopes and resolver configuration evidence.

name: Enterprise VPN and remote access audit
description: Audit supplied remote-access profiles for legacy protocols, MFA, device posture, certificate authentication, split tunnelling, administrator restrictions, logging, key rotation and session timeout.

parameters.profiles: Up to 256 VPN profile records with identity, protocol and security-control evidence.

name: Enterprise network asset lifecycle audit
description: Assess supplied network asset inventory for vendor support lifecycle, stale security updates, confirmed exposure and reported high/critical vulnerability counts. Never invents CVEs or queries outside vulnerability feeds.

parameters.assets: Up to 2048 asset records with support state, criticality, patch and exposure evidence.

name: Enterprise network security evidence report
description: Combine F194-F199 WLAN, switch, firewall, DHCP/DNS, VPN and asset lifecycle audits into a deterministic, privacy-minimised report with evidence gaps, severity rollups and a SHA-256 integrity digest.

parameters.reports: One to six F194-F199 audit result objects.

name: Multi-AP RF channel reuse planner
description: Generate a bounded heuristic channel assignment across same-site AP radios using channel options already validated by the operator and explicit weighted RF interference evidence; report baseline comparison, convergence and residual overlap without applying configuration.

parameters.radios: 1-256 radios with site/AP/radio identity, band, channel width, current channel and 1-32 channel options already validated for the radio and regulatory domain
parameters.interference_edges: Up to 8192 same-site/same-band AP radio relationships with explicit 0-1 relative weights and survey/controller/operator provenance
parameters.change_penalty: Optional 0-0.5 penalty per changed radio to balance interference reduction and deployment churn

name: RF survey evidence normalizer
description: Normalize timestamped paired RSSI readings collected by one survey receiver at a common point, plus optional channel-load observations, into fresh provenance-labelled relative co-visibility/load weights for the F201 multi-AP planner.

parameters.radios: 2-256 radio IDs with site and band context
parameters.observations: 1-8192 pair observations with sample ID, radio IDs, timezone-aware timestamp, two RSSI readings captured at the same survey point in radio_ids order, and optional channel utilization/retry percentages
parameters.max_age_days: Optional 1-30 day freshness window; defaults to 7 days

name: Client roam transaction analyzer
description: Correlate explicit per-client roam-start, roam-complete and roam-failure events to calculate successful roam latency percentiles, matched failure rates, incomplete telemetry and disassociation reasons.

parameters.events: 1-10000 timestamped association, disassociation and roam transaction events, scoped by site and pseudonymous client reference
parameters.slow_roam_threshold_ms: Optional 50-30000 ms threshold for completed roam transactions; defaults to 1000 ms

name: Client experience SLO evaluator
description: Aggregate fresh timestamped per-client Wi-Fi measurements against configurable signal, SNR, retry, airtime, loss, latency, jitter and optional throughput thresholds; report coverage and SLO attainment without counting missing required telemetry as a pass.

parameters.samples: 1-10000 timestamped sample records with site ID, pseudonymous client reference, evidence source and supplied metric values
parameters.required_metrics: Optional metric names that must be present before a sample enters the SLO denominator
parameters.thresholds: Optional metric thresholds; defaults are documented in the result and throughput is unscored unless min throughput is supplied
parameters.as_of: Optional timezone-aware assessment timestamp for deterministic reports; defaults to server UTC time
parameters.max_age_days: Optional freshness window from 1 to 30 days; defaults to 7
